solution.title: macOS Identity-Threat & Account-Lockout Hardening (Password Spray, Smart Lockout, SecureToken)

products.name: macOS Identity-Threat & Account-Lockout Hardening (Password Spray, Smart Lockout, SecureToken) — Commercial
products.short_description: Harden the identity posture of the Mac fleet — find and stop Mac-originated failed sign-ins that drive password-spray detections and account lockouts, enforce Smart Lockout + MFA, and clean up stale Mac credential state. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Stop Macs from triggering account lockouts and credential attacks

macOS clients with saved or stale credentials can hammer Entra ID with failed sign-ins — feeding password-spray detections and triggering account lockouts that block legitimate users, sometimes tangled up with SecureToken/keychain state. This solution hardens the identity posture of the Mac fleet: understand and mitigate lockout sources, enforce Entra Smart Lockout and MFA, and clean up the Mac-side credential state that causes repeat failures — under Zero-Trust and least-privilege.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — how macOS authentication, saved credentials, and keychain/SecureToken state contribute to failed sign-ins, lockouts, and password-spray noise, and the hardening model.
  • Requirements Guide — prerequisites (Entra sign-in logs / Identity Protection, Smart Lockout, MFA, Intune, a pilot) with how to verify/implement each.
  • Implementation Guide — exact steps to identify Mac-originated lockout/spray sources from sign-in logs, enforce Smart Lockout + MFA, remediate stale Mac-side credentials/keychain, and validate the reduction, then expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — sign-in-failure/lockout discovery (by device/OS), per-device credential-state validation, a lockout/spray exposure report, safe remediation guidance, and a target-group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides (lockout sources identified, failures reduced) plus Best Practices for identity protection on Macs.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Fewer account lockouts and less password-spray noise from the Mac fleet — sources identified, Smart Lockout + MFA enforced, stale credentials cleaned — proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • MACLOCK-Discovery.ps1 — identify Mac-originated failed sign-ins, lockouts, and spray sources plus current Smart Lockout / MFA posture (Graph)
    • MACLOCK-Remediation.ps1 — safe remediation of Mac-originated lockout/spray sources (defaults to -WhatIf)
    • MACLOCK-Report.ps1 — before/after lockout-and-spray exposure report for the Mac fleet (Graph)
    • MACLOCK-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — create the Mac scope Entra groups (pilot / broad)
    • MACLOCK-Validation.ps1 — do Smart Lockout + the MFA policy match the register, and did Mac failures drop? (Graph)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
